# Web Content Extractor
Downloads a web page and extracts its readable text, links and optional page metadata.
## When to use
- A step needs the content of a web page for summarizing, indexing or answering.
## How it works
1. Fetches `websiteurl`. 2. Removes scripts, styles and tags, decodes entities, and normalizes whitespace. 3. Collects all links. If `extractmetadata` is true, also reads title, description, keywords, language, canonical URL and Open Graph tags.
## Inputs
- `websiteurl`: The full URL of the website to fetch - `requestmethod`: The HTTP request method to use, e.g. GET or POST - `extractmetadata`: Whether to also extract page metadata such as title and description - `maxcontentlength`: Maximum content size in bytes, default 10 MB - `useragent`: User-Agent header to send
## Outputs
- `extractedcontent`, `webpagemetadata`, `extractedlinks`, `extractionstatus`, `extractiondate`, `errormessage`
## Notes
- `requestmethod`, `maxcontentlength` and `useragent` are read but the fetch currently always uses the shared HTTP connection defaults.
## Implementation
- Bean `webContentExtractorSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.WebContentExtractorSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`
